measurement: Check the size label on your Unloader One X brace and order the matching liner size (XS-M or L-XL). Reference calf circumference: XS-M: 9.75 to 16.75 in. (25 to 43 cm); L-XL: 16.75 to 24.38 in. (43 to 62 cm), measured 6 in. (15 cm) below the center of the kneecap with the leg fully extended. Always match liner size to your brace, not just your calf measurement. For personalized sizing assistance, take advantage of our Perfect Fit Guarantee .
